ambiguities_resolved_fail_closed: interpretation, fail-closed: Approvals bind to the proposal digest, revision, release and expiry (ADD v1.3 :2849) and the GatePackage freezes the ApprovalSet digest (LLD v1.1 :320); R2 admits exactly one and R3 exactly two Approvals (an extra Approval is QUORUM_NOT_MET); DOMAIN_APPROVER and NATIONAL_APPROVER are the role tokens of the identity registry for the ADD v1.3 :3338 roles and, like the reason codes of the gates, are not normative names

interpretation, fail-closed: the engine maps every G-APPROVAL failure to APPROVAL_MISSING and every G-DECISION failure other than REJECT to DECISION_MISSING, with the gate's reason code in cause_code; an ActionType with a non-canonical target is refused by the engine (TARGET_NOT_CANONICAL) because the engine commits canonical state; an IRREVERSIBLE ActionType must be R3_HIGH_IMPACT and not compensable (ADD v1.3 :3302-3303); ActionProposal.action_id and aggregate_id are read-only properties (the canonical aggregate of a canonical action is its target)

interpretation, fail-closed: G-AUTHORITY checks signature, closed record, capability, principal, verified Delegation, action instance, GCS and window without consuming; the fence repeats all of them and consumes; the post-commit delivery of the committed outbox event to the sink is the C7 relay, not a C6 command dispatch
